paite: Hiaite ahi Israel suante'n Kanaan gam alak ua, siampu Eleazar, Nun tapa Joshua leh Israel suante nam inkuan lupente'n agouluah ding ua ana hawm uh.
heading: Jordan Tumlam Gam Hawmna
english: These are the inheritances which the children of Israel took in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed to them,

paite: Nam kuate leh nam kimkhatte a tuam dia TOUPA'N Mosi zang a thu ana piak bang in aisan in agouluah uh piak ahi.
english: by the lot of their inheritance, as Yahweh commanded by Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half-tribe.

paite: Mosi in nam nih leh nam kimkhatte Jordan gal ah agouluah ding uh ana peta hi. Levi chite bel alak uah gouluah ding ape kei hi.
english: For Moses had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half-tribe beyond the Jordan; but to the Levites he gave no inheritance among them.

paite: Joseph suante nam nih ahi ua, Manasseh leh Ephraim. Levi chite huai gam ah tantuam ape kei uh, a-omna ding uh khopite leh adaikim ua gantatna ding mun leh a-inn leh alou uh bawlna ding lou ngal piak ahi kei uhi.
english: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. They gave no portion to the Levites in the land, except cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for their livestock and for their property.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in Israel suante'n ahih ua, gam ahawm uhi.
english: The children of Israel did as Yahweh commanded Moses, and they divided the land.

paite: Judah suante Gilgal ah Joshua kiang ah ava hoh ua; Keniz mi Jephunneh tapa Kaleb in akiang ah, "Kadesh-barnea mun a Pathian mipa Mosi kiang a TOUPA'N ka tungtang leh na tungtang thu ana gen na thei hi.
heading: Kaleb Kiang Ah Hebron Piak Ahi
english: Then the children of Judah came near to Joshua in Gilgal. Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, “You know the thing that Yahweh spoke to Moses the man of God concerning me and concerning you in Kadesh Barnea.

paite: TOUPA sikha Mosi in Kadesh-barnea mun a pan gam va enkhe dia ahon sawl lai in kum sawmli a upa ka na hita a; ka lungsim a om bangtak akiang ah ka tun nawn hi.
english: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of Yahweh sent me from Kadesh Barnea to spy out the land. I brought him word again as it was in my heart.

paite: Himahleh ka unau ka kiang a pai samte'n mipite lungtang azulsuaksak ua; ke'n bel TOUPA ka Pathian ka zui hi.
english: Nevertheless, my brothers who went up with me made the heart of the people melt; but I wholly followed Yahweh my God.

paite: Mosi in huai ni in, TOUPA ka Pathian na zuih ziak in na khe in ana siksa gam tangtawn in nang leh na suante gouluah ahi ngeingei ding, chi in akichiam hi.
english: Moses swore on that day, saying, ‘Surely the land where you walked shall be an inheritance to you and to your children forever, because you have wholly followed Yahweh my God.’

paite: Huchi in ngai in, TOUPA'N Mosi kiang a huai thute agen nung Israelte gamdai a, avakvaih sung un TOUPA'N agensa bang in kum sawmli-le-nga tak ahon damsak lai hi. Ngai in, tu in kum sawmgiat-le-nga ka hita.
english: “Now, behold, Yahweh has kept me alive, as he spoke, these forty-five years, from the time that Yahweh spoke this word to Moses, while Israel walked in the wilderness. Now, behold, I am eighty-five years old, today.

paite: Hichi pipi in leng Mosi in ahon sawl lai mah bang in ka hat lai a, nidanglai a kidouna ding leh nasep silbawlna dia thagui ka neih mah bang in tu in leng ka nei lai hi.
english: As yet I am as strong today as I was in the day that Moses sent me. As my strength was then, even so is my strength now for war, to go out and to come in.

paite: Huaiziak in hiai tang, TOUPA'N huai ni a agensa pen hon pia in, Anakte a-om ua, akhopite uh athupi a, kulhbaang a umsuak ahi uh, chih huai ni in na za a; TOUPA'N ahon ompih dia, amaute ka delhkhe thei ding, TOUPA'N ana gensa bang in," achi hi.
english: Now therefore give me this hill country, of which Yahweh spoke in that day; for you heard in that day how the Anakim were there, and great and fortified cities. It may be that Yahweh will be with me, and I shall drive them out, as Yahweh said.”

paite: Joshua in avualzawl a; Jephunneh tapa Kaleb gouluah ding in Hebron khua apeta hi.
english: Joshua blessed him; and he gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance.

paite: Huaiziak in Hebron khua tuni tan in Keniz mi, Jephunneh tapa Kaleb gouluah ahong hita hi; TOUPA Israelte' Pathian azuih ziak in.
english: Therefore Hebron became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite to this day, because he followed Yahweh, the God of Israel wholeheartedly.

paite: Hebron kho min ama in Kiriath-arba ahi. Arba ahihleh Anakte lak a mithupipen ahi. Huai khit in agam ahong galmuangta hi.
english: Now the name of Hebron before was Kiriath Arba, after the greatest man among the Anakim. Then the land had rest from war.
